scope: S4 priority and closure planning only; no implementation/build/native execution
owner_statement:
Prioritize S4 completion. Reconcile every remaining S4 obligation against the committed implementation and existing proof, including the accepted pointer assessment.

Produce a finite closure checklist identifying:

Requirements already satisfied, with evidence.
Actual remaining S4 implementation or correctness gaps.
Qualification obligations that belong to S5.
Baseline/budget work retained separately under GBB-P05.

Cite the controlling requirement for each claimed blocker. Do not reintroduce withdrawn 4/8 ms gates, restart optimization, or treat all unfinished qualification as S4 implementation work.

Reconcile the roadmap with this owner priority. Complete the authorized planning and present the smallest concrete residual implementation/proof scope needed to close S4. If existing evidence already satisfies an obligation, credit it rather than repeating it. Preserve explicit gaps; do not declare closure without evidence.
